captains_call.title: Mac mini after the Mac Studio move
captains_call.about: The Mac Studio now runs the fleet, so the Mac mini has no job. This is open because the move finished on 2026-10-09.
captains_call.decide: What should the Mac mini do now?

options.label: Keep as cold spare
options.hint: It stays powered off; it can take over in about an hour if the Studio fails.

options.label: Run CI runners
options.hint: It runs the self-hosted test jobs; it uses about 20 W all day.

options.label: Sell it
options.hint: It brings back cash now; there is no spare if the Studio fails.

captains_call.recommend_reason: A spare costs nothing while off and removes the single point of failure the move created.
facts: The Studio is now the only fleet host (fleet inventory, 2026-10-09).
Standard CI already runs on hosted runners (CI config).
counterfacts: If hosted CI minutes run out, the CI option wins (billing page).
A resale price drops each quarter the mini stays idle.

options.label: Merge now
options.hint: The fix ships to the fleet on next sync.

captains_call.title: GitHub login
captains_call.about: PR checks cannot run because the gh token expired; only you can sign in.
captains_call.decide: Run gh auth login on the Studio.

options.label: I signed in
options.hint: Workers retry the blocked PR checks.
